decision_scope: Stop the current RunPod pod-placement campaign before Phase B and pivot the placement strategy. This is not evidence that the co-design thesis is false; it is evidence that this campaign cannot validly test it on the admissible RunPod placements.
rubric_trigger: A valid stock and tuned-incumbent baseline cannot be obtained under the admissible placement rules, so Gate B cannot pass and later representation, quality, intervention, holdout, and specificity phases may not start.
measured_results: Direct authenticated RunPod inventory, billing, create, get, delete, and prior delete-verification paths are operational.
The campaign suite passes 68/68 tests and the GLM experiment suite passes 21/21 tests.
Historical H100 evidence proves the pinned CUDA-13 SGLang runtime loads native BF16 GLM-4.7-Flash and produces two identical deterministic greedy smoke completions.
No valid BF16 throughput, TTFT, token-level ITL, SLO-goodput, provisional quality, or GPU-dollar-per-token control exists.
The preregistered Community A100 80 GB PCIe request returned HTTP 500 before pod creation. Inventory remained empty and cost was $0.
The second and final changed Secure A100 80 GB PCIe request also returned HTTP 500 before pod creation. Inventory remained empty and cost was $0.

All 22 historical billing rows are settled at $4.944724685 provider-reported account lifetime spend. Conservative account lifetime spend remains $5.153606502 because the interrupted L40S allocation is retained at its larger local upper bound.
Campaign-additional spend remains $0.273464527; both Phase-B placement requests created no allocation and added $0.
The AWQ path has a source-supported, offline-tested fix for the measured dense-only KV-B post-load assumption, but that branch has not executed on GPU and cannot advance before Gate B.
analytical_estimates: The prospective Secure A100 c8 stock prediction was 250 conservative output tokens/second with a 140 to 400 interval; it remains unscored because no pod was created.
RunPod's queried A100 prices and the Fireworks/Baseten accelerator rates are price anchors only; no matched workload, quality, or SLO result exists.
Cloudflare's public GLM-4.7-Flash token price is a commercial anchor only and cannot be compared to local GPU cost without matched responses and service evidence.
vendor_claims: Cloudflare publishes GLM-4.7-Flash token pricing and a 131072-token context window.
Baseten publishes a GLM-4.7-Flash deployment template described as optimized for 2xH100, not a matched managed-API benchmark.
Fireworks and Baseten publish GLM 4.7 serverless prices, but those listings are not the GLM-4.7-Flash checkpoint measured here.
claims_not_supported: No AWQ compatibility, quality, throughput, or economic gain.
No model-specific kernel or scheduling gain.
No Fireworks, Baseten, or Cloudflare performance comparison.
No memory-hierarchy or hardware co-design benefit.
No PROMOTE case for a $1000 campaign.
why_not_continue_spending: The two allowed A100 PCIe placements failed before allocation with two distinct cloud classes.
Historical H100 placements already exhibited repeated image-readiness failures and the plan forbids more unchanged cold H100 retries.
Phase C and the causally changed AWQ smoke are gated on a valid stock/tuned baseline.
Cycling through more GPU variants would violate the preregistered placement stop rule and convert provider-capacity noise into unbounded spend.

single_next_experiment_after_pivot.experiment: Run the existing 25-request stock BF16 harness once on a guaranteed 80 GB NVIDIA placement with the exact pinned image pre-pulled or provider-reserved, then run the matched supported tuned control on the same machine only if stock passes.
single_next_experiment_after_pivot.required_change: Placement must be guaranteed or demonstrably cache-ready before billing; it may not be another best-effort RunPod request identical to the failed placements.
single_next_experiment_after_pivot.information_value: This isolates model/runtime/SLO performance from the provider-capacity and image-readiness failure that prevented Gate B.
prerequisites: fresh explicit authorization for the changed placement mechanism or provider
same frozen workload, quality, SLO, telemetry, and evidence contracts
new prospective prediction and spend admission
